headline: US payroll data show jobs held by 22 to 25 year olds in the roles most exposed to AI shrank 4.4 percent in the year to August.
score_reason: Useful data point, but only a short segment description was available and the figure is for August.
importance_line: Young workers in AI-exposed jobs have seen employment fall every month for two years, but the short report does not prove AI is the cause.
source: France 24, citing the Stanford Digital Economy Lab and ADP Research
summary: France 24 reports, citing the Canaries Dashboard of the Stanford Digital Economy Lab and ADP Research, that US employment in the jobs most exposed to AI for people aged 22 to 25 fell 4.4 percent in the year to August 2026. The jobs have shrunk every month since October 2023, about a year after ChatGPT's release, though the report describes the pattern without proving AI is the cause.
notes: France 24 page blocked; text read on Inbox.lv copy, credited to France 24. Data are for August, so freshness set to follow-up; score kept at 5 because the segment aired 6 Oct.
